title: CDS Full Length Mock Test 03 (Hard Level)
description: Combined Defence Services Examination style full-length mock covering English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions.
instructions: There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
Choose the most appropriate option among the four given choices.
The paper covers English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge as in CDS.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part that contains an error: Neither the captain nor the lieutenants / was ready / to abandon / the position.
options: Neither the captain nor the lieutenants
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor' the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'lieutenants'; use 'were ready'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The committee / have submitted / its report / to the Ministry.
questions.explanation: Collective noun 'committee' as a unit takes singular 'has submitted'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Scarcely had the convoy entered the pass / when the first shots / was fired / from the ridge.
options: Scarcely had the convoy entered the pass
questions.explanation: 'Shots' is plural; use 'were fired'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Every one of the cadets / have to pass / the endurance test / before commissioning.
questions.explanation: 'Every one of' takes singular verb 'has to pass'.

He is senior from all his colleagues.

options: If I were the commander, I would have held the bridge.
If I was the commander, I would hold the bridge.
If I had been the commander, I would hold the bridge.
questions.explanation: Hypothetical condition takes subjunctive 'were'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to passive: The Navy commissioned three new frigates last year.
options: Three new frigates were commissioned by the Navy last year.
Three new frigates have been commissioned by the Navy last year.
Three new frigates was commissioned by the Navy last year.
Three new frigates are commissioned by the Navy last year.
questions.explanation: Simple past active becomes simple past passive.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I shall hold the post till reinforcements arrive.'
options: He said that he would hold the post till reinforcements arrived.
He said that he shall hold the post till reinforcements arrive.
He said that he should hold the post till reinforcements arrive.
He said that he will hold the post till reinforcements arrived.
questions.explanation: Shall → would; present 'arrive' → 'arrived' in reported speech.
